description: This PHP class represents a 'Language' entity in a Human Resource Management System. It is mapped to the 'ohrm_language' database table and manages properties such as 'id' and 'name', along with a collection of associated 'EmployeeLanguage' entities. The class includes getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents a language entity with properties for its identifier and name, and a collection of associated EmployeeLanguage entities. Mapped to the 'ohrm_language' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the language.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the language.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the language.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the language.
